title: Cumulative Satellite Detected Waters and Impact in Kenya between 24 to 28 April 2024
notes: **UNOSAT code: FL20240426KEN** This map illustrates cumulative satellite-detected water using NOAA-VIIRS acquired between the 24th and the 28th of April 2024. about 3,800 km² of land appear to be flooded.
